# 2B.4 Research Note: Civilian Protection, IHL, Necessity, and Proportionality in 2024
...
This is a new isolated workflow: do not use or inspect any repository process, skill, dossier, code, or existing research. Write a compact Markdown research note. For every accepted claim, provide title, publisher, date, recoverable page URL, a short claim-level summary, and question IDs. You are responsible for all research selection and summaries; a later model will only copy your work into JSON. If reliable evidence is genuinely absent, explain the search gap specifically.
